title: Total RNA Extraction, cDNA Synthesis, and qPCR
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iaucaew

steps.title: Seed and Culture Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells at a density of 1×10^5 cells/well in a 24-well plate and culture them under 5% CO2 in a 95% humidified atmosphere at 37℃.

steps.title: Extract Total Cellular RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total cellular RNA 48 h post-transfection using a Total RNA Extraction Kit (Promega, USA) following these steps:

substeps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBS.
Strip cells with a cell scraper and collect in a nuclease-free EP tube by centrifugation at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes; discard the supernatant.
Add 100 μl of RNA lysate to the cell pellet, resuspend with a pipette, transfer to a 1.5 ml nuclease-free EP tube, add 100 μl of dilution, and mix by inverting four times.
Incubate the lysate at 70℃ for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes and carefully aspirate the supernatant into a 1.5 ml nuclease-free EP tube.
Add 0.5 times the supernatant volume of anhydrous ethanol and mix 4 times with a pipette.
Transfer the mixture to the centrifuge column (add in batches if volume exceeds 750 μl).
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 1 minute, discard the filtrate, and return the column to the collection tube.
Add 600 μl wash buffer to the column, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 45 seconds, and discard the filtrate.

steps.title: Perform DNase I Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the RNA with DNase I to remove DNA contamination:

substeps.instruction: Prepare the DNase I incubation solution in a nuclease-free tube by mixing 5 μl of 10 × DNase I buffer, 5 μl of DNase I, and 40 μl of nuclease-free water.
Add 50 μl of the freshly prepared DNase I incubation solution to the centrifuge tube and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Complete the RNA purification and elution process:

substeps.instruction: Add 600 μl RNA wash buffer to the column, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 45 seconds, and discard the filtrate.
Repeat the wash step once more, then centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 2 minutes.
Transfer the centrifuge column into the elution tube, add 50 μl of nuclease-free water to the spin-off membrane, incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes, and centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 1 minute.
Add the elution solution to the center of the column, incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes, and centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 1 minute to elute RNA again.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the extracted RNA by measuring the absorbance at 260 nm.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription to synthesize cDNA using the following system and thermal profile:

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 20 μl reaction mixture: 4 μl 5 × RT Master Mix (TaKaRa, Japan), 2 μg RNA, and RNase-free ddH2O to reach 20 μl.
Run the RT-PCR procedure: 25℃ for 5 minutes, 37℃ for 30 minutes, 85℃ for 10 seconds, and 12℃ for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Perform qPCR
steps.instruction: Analyze gene expression using qPCR with the following system and thermal profile:

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 20 μl reaction on ice: 1 μl cDNA mixture, 10 μl 2 × Top Green qPCR Super Mix (Transgen, China), 1 μl upstream primer (10 mM), 1 μl downstream primer (10 mM), and ddH2O to reach 20 μl.
Run the qPCR procedure: Step 1: 95℃ for 5 minutes; Step 2: 40 cycles of (95℃ for 30 seconds, 55℃ for 30 seconds, 72℃ for 10 seconds); Step 3: 72℃ for 5 minutes; Step 4: 4℃ hold.

steps.title: Calculate Relative Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Calculate relative gene expression by comparing the CT value of the gene of interest with that of GAPDH (internal control).
